sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish

feed.title: Coca-Cola Activates its Largest Footprint Yet at Essence Festival
feed.summary: Coca-Cola significantly expanded its presence at the Essence Festival of Culture with "Shine City," a revamped expo activation that integrated three of its brands: Coca-Cola, smartwater, and Simply. The activation, designed by Atlanta illustrator Shae Anthony, used cohesive visuals and diverse programming to engage festival-goers, resulting in record-setting brand affinity scores and positive purchase intent. Coca-Cola aimed to reflect the multifaceted nature of Black culture through various zones like the Soda Bar, Shine City Marketplace for Black-owned businesses, a smartwater Social Club for relaxation, and a Simply House focused on hosting.

feed.title: Is Kroger coming back to Columbus? New project plans suggest a return

feed.title: Federal appeals court affirms Enbridge's Line 5 pipeline is trespassing on Bad River reservation land, grants company more time to reroute
feed.summary: A U.S. Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals ruling upheld a lower court's finding that Enbridge Energy's Line 5 pipeline is trespassing on the Bad River Band of Lake Superior Chippewa reservation. While confirming the trespass, the appeals court reversed the 2023 deadline for pipeline removal, instructing the lower court to balance tribal and public interests for a "reasonable" reroute window. The decision also dismissed the public-nuisance claim and ordered a recalculation of the $5.15 million restitution.

feed.title: Carbon superhighway reimagines CO2 movement at scale
feed.summary: ExxonMobil is developing a "carbon superhighway" along the Gulf Coast to address the limitations of traditional point-to-point carbon capture and storage (CCS) models. This integrated network connects multiple CO2 emitters to various storage sites and customers, offering greater flexibility for captured CO2 to be directed to permanent storage, enhanced oil recovery, or industrial uses. The system is designed to expand easily as new projects are added, allowing for efficient and scalable CO2 management.

feed.title: SLB, Equinor to Upgrade Vessel Under Multi-Year Well Stimulation Deal
